title: Tag in the Fog
lines: Sid, Pam and a dog sit at a mat.
Sid and the dog tag in the fog.
The dog is not at the mat. It is not at the pot.
Pam and Sid tap a pan in the fog.
The dog is at the mat!
Sid and it nap at the pit.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
